name: list
title: List
description: Rows of things with media, words and something at the end.
use: Members, files, integrations or settings: each row has something to recognize it by, a title with an optional second line, and a value, a status or a control at its end. It has no surface of its own: put it in a card or a sheet.

instead.when: Rows are compared column by column
It states the facts about one thing as terms and values
It is a short list of destinations with icons and no second line
The rows are options chosen with the keys
The items are sentences in running text

platform.fallback: The hairline under a row spans the whole row instead of starting at the words

classes.name: list-row
classes.description: A row: a list item, or a link or a button when the whole row goes somewhere

classes.name: list-media
classes.description: What the row is recognized by, at its start: an avatar, an icon or a thumbnail

classes.name: list-body
classes.description: The words: a title and an optional description

classes.name: list-title
classes.description: The name of the row, on one line that ends in an ellipsis

classes.name: list-description
classes.description: A quieter second line, on one line that ends in an ellipsis

classes.name: list-end
classes.description: A value, a status or a control at the end of the row

classes.name: list-interactive
classes.description: Rows that open or select: each is a rounded target that answers the pointer and a press, at least 44px tall on a touch screen, and the hairlines are not drawn

states.name: current
states.description: In an interactive list, or aria-current="true": the row takes a chip tone

states.name: selected
states.description: In an interactive list: the row takes a chip tone

states.name: disabled
states.description: In an interactive list, or aria-disabled="true" on a link: disabled ink and no answer to the pointer

properties.name: --list-gap
properties.description: Space between media, words and end
